## Commands

| Command | Who | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mcperks slots <player> <n> [days] [ref]` | console / admin | Grant (or with a negative `n`, take back) character slots |
| `mcperks tier <player> <tier> [days] [ref]` | console / admin | Put an account on a membership tier |
| `mcperks revoke <player> [slots\|tier\|all]` | console / admin | Drop grants. No third argument means everything |
| `mcperks info <player>` | console / admin | Every grant on record and the totals |
| `mcperks refresh [player]` | console / admin | Drop the cached membership and Discord roles, then resolve again |
| `mcperks discord [playerId]` | console / admin | Discord config, and a live lookup role by role |
| `mcperks tebex` | console / admin | Force a price sync and print what the webstore answered |
| `mcperks payments [count]` | console / admin | Recent purchases, and whether each package is mapped |
| `mcperks claim <player> <transaction>` | console / admin | Read one payment back off Tebex and write its grants |
| `mcdiag` | console | Reprint the startup report. **This is the block to attach to a support ticket** |
| `mcdiag debug` | console | Turn `Config.Debug` on or off without a restart |
| `/setslots [id] [slots]` | admin | Set the account's **base** slots, before membership |
| `/remslots [id]` | admin | Put them back on `Config.Slots` |
| `/lockchar [id] [slot]` | admin | Lock a character so it cannot be played |
| `/unlockchar [id] [slot]` | admin | Unlock it again |
| `/mctattoos [player\|charKey]` | admin | Report both copies of a character's ink and put them back in step |
| `/mcorphans [clean]` | admin | List rows belonging to characters that no longer exist; `clean` deletes them |
| `/relog` | player | Back to the character screen (disable with `Config.Relog`) |
| `/ccpos` | any | Print ped/camera/aim lines for `Config.Scene` |
| `/ccspawn [id] [label]` | any | Print a complete `Config.Spawns` entry for where you are standing |
| `/ccdebug` | any | Live vs configured camera framing for the current step |
| `/cctattoo [collection] [overlay]` | any | Try one decoration, or with no arguments the whole configured list |
| `/ccpose [slot] [n]` | any | List line-up poses and whether the game has each clip |
| `/ccblend` | any | List and try the `Config.Heritage` presets |
| `/ccbackdrop` | any | Toggle the backdrop image |

All are plain `RegisterCommand`s, so every one works from the console — which is
how Tebex delivers a purchase. In game they need a framework admin (ESX
`admin`/`superadmin`, QB/Qbox `admin`) or `add_ace <group> command.mcperks allow`.

`<player>` is a server id for anyone online, or an identifier for anybody at all.
Every shape your framework might have written is understood — `license:1a2b3c…`,
a bare licence, `char2:1a2b3c…` or a citizenid.
